claim_text_original: Wire/fiber jamming for variable stiffness is novel.
claim_text_normalized: Variable bending stiffness achieved via frictional jamming of metallic or synthetic wire/fiber bundles.
why_potentially_novel: At mentor proposal, using parallel wire bundles instead of granular media or planar sheets was hypothesized to offer higher bending stiffness contrast and directional compliance.
search_conducted: MP1-V001 core prior-art search across IEEE, MDPI, and Copernicus publications.

strongest_prior_art_threat.paper_title: Detachable Soft Actuators with Tunable Stiffness Based on Wire Jamming
strongest_prior_art_threat.repository_path: data/papers/verification/MP1-V001/2022-Detachable Soft Actuators with Tunable Stiffness Based on Wire Jamming.pdf
strongest_prior_art_threat.what_source_actually_proves: Demonstrates that vacuum-activated frictional jamming of kraft ropes, hemp ropes, and nylon wires inside a flexible sleeve achieves an ~7x increase in bending stiffness (from 0.13 to 0.89 N/mm).
strongest_prior_art_threat.what_source_does_not_prove: Does not use shape memory alloys (NiTi) and does not examine phase-transformation-mediated contact mechanics.

source_records.paper_title: Detachable Soft Actuators with Tunable Stiffness Based on Wire Jamming
source_records.repository_path: data/papers/verification/MP1-V001/2022-Detachable Soft Actuators with Tunable Stiffness Based on Wire Jamming.pdf
source_records.what_source_actually_proves: Frictional wire jamming yields tunable bending stiffness under negative pressure.

source_records.paper_title: A variable stiffness omnidirectional chain based on positive-pressure fiber jamming
source_records.repository_path: data/papers/verification/MP1-V001/2026-A variable stiffness omnidirectional chain based on positive-pressure fiber jamming.pdf
source_records.what_source_actually_proves: Models and experimentally confirms 3-regime friction mechanics (jammed, transition, slipping) in a 700-fiber nylon bundle under positive confinement pressure up to 300 kPa.
source_records.what_source_does_not_prove: Does not examine metallic superelasticity or phase transformation.

claim_before: Wire/fiber jamming for variable stiffness is novel.
claim_after: Wire/fiber jamming is established prior art; device-level novelty rejected.
reason_for_change: Direct prior art in Bai et al. (2022) and Zhang & Yao (2026) fully demonstrates the working principle and mechanics of wire/fiber jamming.
scientific_consequence: Forced abandonment of generic wire-jamming claims; project cannot claim novelty merely by using a bundle of wires.
feasibility_impact: Confirms mechanical viability of wire jamming, but eliminates patentable or novel device claims.
pivot_relevance: Direct trigger for PIVOT_TO_MECHANICS_CORE in MP1-V001.
historical_interpretation: At V001 (S04), classified as directly closed. At Stage 3 (S12), confirmed as robust closure with residual caveat that material changes do not restore novelty.
superseded_interpretation: Initial belief at proposal that wire jamming was an unexploited mechanism.
corrected_interpretation: Wire jamming is established prior art; material substitution to NiTi only matters if new mechanics arise.
